notes.title: Latest Updates / Demo v66-76 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p]Hello![/p][p]It's been a while and a lot of development has been happening! Still aiming to release the game in singleplayer early access this year, but there is a small chance it gets pushed into 2026. The biggest hurdle that remains is finishing gamepad support. To help ensure that the game releases soon, it would be a huge help if you helped playtest the early access game and contribute feedback, [url="https://discord.gg/aDHjwKts4m"]Join the Discord[/url] if you're interested! [/p][p]Below are all the latest patch notes for the demo. A fun little feature that I just pushed to the demo is chainable ziplines!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44335689/885f78eed2f06c04be61a90da9ad007a993872de.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Skyformer Demo v66-v76 Patch Notes[/p][p]Features:[/p][list][*][p]Add chainable ziplines.[/p][/*][*][p]Support capital letters when typing in text boxes.[/p][/*][*][p]Building HP updates now show at a longer range.[/p][/*][*][p]Add a recipe viewer window in the drone view so you don't have to go to a factory to check the recipes.[/p][/*][*][p]Compass now shows a marker when an object is marked in the world during objective.[/p][/*][*][p]Add ability to delete items.[/p][/*][*][p]Input remapping: display existing control while remapping, and add a reset to defaults button.[/p][/*][*][p]Show cargo drone item delivery rates in various places.[/p][/*][*][p]Show predicted terraform rating before doing an operation. Also base the number of weather stations / drone platforms needed on the predicted terraform rating (allows undoing operations more easily).[/p][/*][*][p]New elevator model design and logic that prevents getting stuck.[/p][/*][*][p]Make the base temperature and storm display double-sided.[/p][/*][*][p]Deep ocean is now accessible to the player (instead of just getting blocked) but deals much more damage.[/p][/*][*][p]New horizontal FOV slider setting,[/p][/*][*][p]Grey background added to the sliding notifications (e.g. +1 Charged Gem) so that you can see it clearly in snowy areas.[/p][/*][/list][p]Bugs:[/p][list][*][p]Fix bug where charge didn't drain in skybase (related to doors and elevators).[/p][/*][*][p]Fix bugs where game crashes when you have more than 200 factories.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix bug with sounds when audio devices are disconnected/connected.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix bug where static noise would play during certain sound effects on certain machines.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix bug where the player location icon wasn't exactly at the player location on the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix bug with sound effect prioritization.[/p][/*][*][p]Several power plant bug fixes (related to their hp hitting zero).[/p][/*][*][p]Fix bug where sound volumes get changed to max after changing sound devices.[/p][/*][/list][p]Other:[/p][list][*][p]Reduce player bounding radius (player can now move through all the tight corners in the base).[/p][/*][*][p]Improve data center status UI text formatting.[/p][/*][*][p]Paginate sound devices screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Added numbers to the HP display.[/p][/*][*][p]Make the drone route viz show the route direction a little bit more clearly.[/p][/*][*][p]Better way of displaying detected resources (it's now a window with acknowledge button).[/p][/*][*][p]Indicate the name of the mined resource in the miner interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Plants and buildings continue to get re-used if using them from the hot bar.[/p][/*][*][p]New icons for all the gems in the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Display "no items left" when using an item in hot bar and you're out of items.[/p][/*][*][p]Add a helpful message when trying to repair building that has 0 hp.[/p][/*][*][p]Allow withdrawing individual items from rocket platform.[/p][/*][*][p]New little scene in the intro that shows the player, and fix sources of bugs when pressing different keys during the intro cutscene.[/p][/*][*][p]Dust Storm balance improvements.[/p][/*][*][p]Prevent UIs from being "opened" in the background in photo mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Change wording: "Configure Item (optional)" to "Restrict Item (optional)" in the drone route configuration screen to make more sense.[/p][/*][*][p]Mention sprint doesn't use extra charge + add sprint lock to displayed controls at game start.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjust the teleport angle when entering the HQ to be more convenient.[/p][/*][*][p]Revamped tutorial experience based on playtesting data: adjusted models, text, visualizations, etc![/p][/*][*][p]Terrain edits to reduce the chance of getting lost in the demo.[/p][/*][*][p]Update the objectives with more detailed steps and better wording.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug with ocean rendering after teleporting.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduce the amount of glow a bit when looking at drone route visuals.[/p][/*][*][p]Increase speed of drone you pilot in the Drone Control Tower.[/p][/*][*][p]Don't play ocean sound when water around you is frozen.[/p][/*][*][p]Improve the base building positioning algorithm when building below you in the skybase.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix Foundation Floor lighting issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Windows Controlled Folder access denied detection when game starts up (will probably move all the save files to local AppData in the future instead of Documents).[/p][/*][*][p]Various UI improvements and small model adjustments.[/p][/*][*][p]Memory usage optimizations.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Skyformer Demo v62-65 Patch Notes
notes.content: [list][*][p]Ability to pause the game[/p][/*][*][p]Fix issue that causes shadows to pop in and out when rotating camera near high terrain[/p][/*][*][p]Fix bug where buildings become unusable at zero health in certain situations[/p][/*][*][p]Shadow rendering distance increased 3x[/p][/*][*][p]Allow putting custom labels on logistical storage units and base storage units[/p][/*][*][p]Ocean graphics and performance improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Fix bug that prevented adding rockets to Rocket Launch Platform[/p][/*][*][p]Make recipes for basic base items a little cheaper[/p][/*][*][p]Reduce game size from 310MB to 175MB.[/p][/*][*][p]Update base door model to have a window and make transitions much faster when using base doors and elevators[/p][/*][*][p]Handle device disconnects/connects in the sound engine (previously it could cause the game to crash)[/p][/*][*][p]Fix bug where power drone animation plays even if power plant is not functioning[/p][/*][*][p]Allow crafting things when inventory is full but space is available[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed positioning issues with some plants in Planters[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the chance of radioactive storms from Radioactive Gems[/p][/*][*][p]Show notifications that an item is pinned/unpinned[/p][/*][*][p]Update recipe for cargo drone and repair drone to require 1 computer T1 instead of 2 and increase copper wire requirement for computer T1 from 2 to 4[/p][/*][*][p]Construction station requirements are now pinnable[/p][/*][*][p]Ability to grid snap from the Drone View Constructor[/p][/*][*][p]The camera now interpolates to the rock you're mining instead of abruptly snapping[/p][/*][*][p]Improved some areas with messed up terrain[/p][/*][*][p]New weather observation tab in the weather map UI[/p][/*][*][p]Model borders are now slightly thicker[/p][/*][*][p]Server-side memory usage improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Fix bug where oceean temperatures are calculated incorrectly, leading to damage calculation issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where game crashed in Simplified Chinese version[/p][/*][*][p]Small updates to various models and tiny polishes to UI[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Join the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FaDHjwKts4m"]Discord[/url] for more detailed updates, discussions, and upcoming playtests![/p]

notes.title: Skyformer Demo v61 Patch
notes.content: [list][*][p]Fix issue where rebuilding planters caused several bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Newly acquired items stack to the first matching item slot instead of the first empty slot.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix bug where some controls don't work after you die.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced dust storm damage by 20%. Dust storms in the demo are just meant to show you the basics of how storms work and are not that interesting in terms of strategy. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some rough spots in the terrain in various places.[/p][/*][*][p]Graphics work: slightly improved the shading for the terrain, especially for snowy/sandy areas.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Join the [url="https://discord.gg/aDHjwKts4m"]Discord[/url] for more detailed updates, discussions, and upcoming playtests! [/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Upcoming playtesting, v60 update, and Japanese!
notes.content: [p]Hello again![/p][p][/p][p]Wanted to share some of the recent updates on the development and playtesting - it's been a little bumpy so far this month because I've been moving. If you're new here from Automation Fest, welcome![/p][list][*][p]Just pushed a new inventory management update yesterday, allowing operations such as transferring all items of the same type, splitting items with custom amounts, and more. [/p][/*][*][p]There's a mystery (along with a new storm type) in the demo that gets solved in the main game. [/p][/*][*][p]Japanese language is now supported.[/p][/*][*][p]Gamepad support is in progress - will be coordinating playtesting in the [url="https://discord.gg/aDHjwKts4m"]Discord[/url] when ready. [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Full Game Playtesting[/h3][p]If you've played through the demo and provided feedback for it, you'll be eligible to playtest the full game soon! Join the [url="https://discord.gg/aDHjwKts4m"]Discord[/url] and I'll make announcements about signups for this soon. [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks so much for the support and talk to you again soon! [/p]

notes.title: Demo & Roadmap
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

Thank you so much for following my game. I want to share my latest roadmap: 

[b]Current:[/b] Closed beta playtesting
[list]
[*] Join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/aDHjwKts4m]Discord[/url] if you're interested in playing and helping out! 
[/list]
[b]March 2025:[/b] Public Steam demo playtest 
[list]
[*] There will be a "Request Access" button on the Steam Page for the playtest, and I'll be letting a limited number of people in to test and help ensure that the Demo is stable.
[/list]
[b]May 2025:[/b] Free Steam demo

[b]June 2025:[/b] Steam Next Fest

[b]August 2025:[/b] Early access singleplayer PC release

[b]Through 2026:[/b] Multiple new maps and co-op multiplayer for full release

[h3]Stay in the loop[/h3]
[list]
[*] [url=https://discord.com/invite/aDHjwKts4m]Discord[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/@weatherfused]Youtube[/url]
[/list]
Talk to you again soon, thanks!
